QuestInfo.name: The 2nd Gachapon Stamp event is in progress!
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Admin has detailed information regarding the 2nd Gachapon Stamp event.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Admin has informed you that the 2nd Gachapon Stamp event will take place from June 16 to July 14.
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Admin has informed you that the 2nd Gachapon Stamp event will take place from June 16 to July 14.

0.0: Hello, I am a Maple Admin. What is that small reddish light in your pocket? Could it be the Gachapon Stamp?!
0.1: A Gachapon Stamp event with more awesome and incredible trade items is currently in progress! Are you curious about the event?

yes.0: You're curious about the 2nd Gachapon Stamp event, you say? Well, let me answer all of your questions right now!
yes.1: From #eJune 16 to July 13#n, you will automatically receive the same number of Gachapon Stamps as you do for tickets every time you make a Gachapon purchase. So, what can you do with the stamps?
yes.2: You can come and see me to exchange them for various items you've always wanted!
yes.3: Whether it's the Terrifying Horntail Chair, +3 all stat Aura Ring, or Maple Flag for the dedicated Maplers, just name it and it's yours! I even have miraculous medicine to enhance your strength!
yes.4: Stamps can be exchanged until #eJuly 20#n, but you should come see me in town as soon as possible.

no.0: If you are interested in the Gachapon Stamp event in the future, please come and see me. I'll be waiting in town.
